newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down seven cents to 14.10 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down seven cents to 14.10 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell seven cents to 14.10 ringgit ($5.64) a kg on Monday, after tracking a lower close on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Friday, traders said.
"The market followed the LME down but there was some buying at the lower level, so the premium was higher," said a trader.

Initial offers outweighed bids by 88 tonnes to 52. Final turnover was 77 tonnes compared to 132 on Friday. Buyers were from Japan, Europe and Malaysia. The local premium over London rose to $85 from $55 on Friday.
